summary: Prudential Financial filed an 8-K reporting the closing of a $750M aggregate principal sale of 6.250% Fixed-to-Fixed Reset Rate Junior Subordinated Notes due 2056. The notes were issued under an underwriting agreement dated June 1, 2026, with representatives including Wells Fargo, Barclays, Citigroup, Goldman Sachs, and J.P. Morgan. This is a routine debt capital markets transaction, not a special situation. No acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, or other event-driven category applies. The filing is purely a standard current report on Form 8-K for a debt offering.
